positiveComments:
I am so, so very happy that I tried the MEDIHEAL Watermide Toner Pad (100 Pads). I don't write rave reviews often, but this is going to be one. These toner pads have dramatically improved my skincare routine and results, and they have helped to settle and repair my dry, sensitive skin.
These toner pads are thin pieces of fabric liberally soaked in the toner solution. One pad can cover my whole face and neck with plenty of toner leftover. The toner is cool and refreshing to parched, dehydrated, dry, sensitized skin. It does an amazing job of injecting much­needed hydration and moisture into the skin. The toner soaks into the skin nicely, but leaves a lasting layer of hydration and moisture on the surface of the skin. There is no real detectable scent, other than the slightest herbal scent. The toner pads just smell very light, fresh, and refreshing.
I like to use these toner pads as a sort of mini sheet mask on areas where my skin tends to be most parched, irritated, and sensitive. I will often place one pad on each cheek, and let them sit for 20 minutes. This really has a calming, soothing, hydrating effect on my skin. It helps my skin to heal more quickly.
Because my skin is quite sensitive, washing my face too often doesn't produce good results. Even with the most gentle cleansers. I often use these toner pads in place of a cleansing step. They wipe away any residue from previous skincare routines, and they leave my skin feeling super fresh, hydrated, and refreshed. Without any irritation, damage, or breaking down of my skin barrier. These have become the perfect solution for me when I really want to wash my face and start fresh, but I really shouldn't. This product has really changed my skincare routine and the results I get from it.
The packaging is a really beautiful, unique purple plastic jar/case with an inner, refillable tub. The case also contains a pair of handy plastic tweezers, which smartly attach securely to the inside of the lid. The packaging was really well­thought­out. It is highly functional, and it looks beautiful on a vanity. I have not had any issues with the toner pads drying out at all. The cost of these toner pads is also excellent. I consider them to be an excellent value for money.
Overall, I consider these toner pads to be pretty much perfect. They deeply hydrate and moisturize my skin without even the slightest hint of irritation. In fact, they deftly soothe and calm irritated skin, and set it up for quick restoration. I can't say enough good things about these toner pads. I will repurchase (probably for years to come), and I highly recommend them to anyone of any skin type. I don't think you'll be disappointed.
negativeHeadline: I tried the sample and loved...
negativeComments:
I tried the sample and loved it so much I bought the full size! It was out of stock for almost a month, so I had to wait patiently for it to come back. The thin, soft texture is absolutely delightful. I've been a loyal fan of Mediheal sheet masks for over a decade, so I was thrilled that these toner pads work like mini­masks. They're perfect for oily skin ­ hydrating without being heavy. They've been a godsend for combating winter dryness too. Definitely a holy grail product!

1. The pads are so thin, it's a struggle to separate them one by one.
2. The container is too bulky (inconvenient for travel, takes up too much space).
3. They dry out within 5 minutes of application.
4. My skin had a bad reaction...

The sample was amazing, so why is the full­size product so different?

I'd recommend using tweezers from other toner pads. These are ultra­thin, and the included tweezers are too blunt, often picking up two pads at once.

reviews.headline: I ABSOLUTELY LOVE!
reviews.comment:
I love love this product! I've been using mediheal for about I wanna say a year or two now, I originally started with the light blue one, but once I found the different types and found out about the watermide I haven't looked back. I have terrible dry skin and also sensitive, so the brand itself is great, but the watermide just adds a hydration that I just love, especially pairing with my serum, sometimes I honestly feel like I don't even have to put on moisturizer. 

The only bad thing is that it's TERRIBLE for when you're traveling. Maybe I just haven't had the best of luck so do not let me deter you from getting this product. But every time I go out of town and pack my facial products, almost always these pads find a way to tussle and turn about in my luggage and somehow open and leak. Or just leak period. I don't know if the packaging is just super sensitive and causes the top to come open or if you just don't have it sitting upright it leaks from the sides and just all-over, I do not know! I'm starting to think my best bet is to just keep the box for anytime I travel and see how that holds up in my luggage to hopefully seal it and prevent any leaking.

reviews.headline: Fine, but wont be repurchasing
reviews.comment: really wanted to love these. I was hoping these would leave me dewy and plump on days when I don't want to do a full sheet mask. Sadly, these felt like all the juicy goodness evaporated the longer I had them on. I've never had a sheet mask or toner pad make my skin feel drier after. It was odd since these have such good reviews. sometimes it's best to just stick with what you know works well instead of trying something new. :(
